description: A chart-race of Layer‑1 cryptocurrencies (ETH, SOL, BNB, AVAX, LUNA) showing the 2010s boom, the 2021 altcoin explosion, Terra's 2022 implosion and the consolidation that followed. Market‑cap snapshots (Billions USD) per year — dramatic winners, devastating collapses.
youtube_description:
The Chain Shock — a high‑tempo chart race tracking Layer‑1 market caps (ETH, SOL, BNB, AVAX, LUNA) from the pre‑crypto years to 2026. Watch Ethereum's staggering ascent, Solana's meteoric entry and volatility, Binance Coin's ecosystem surge, Avalanche's 2021 breakout — and Terra's jaw‑dropping implosion in 2022 that wiped tens of billions off the market overnight. Data are year‑by‑year market‑cap snapshots (Billions USD) pulled from public historical records (CoinMarketCap / CoinGecko / exchange reports) and mapped to major real events: the 2021 altcoin bubble, the Merge and DeFi growth, outages and exploits that tanked trust, and the post‑2022 consolidation.

If you want more deep dives like this — hits, crashes and the stories behind the numbers — smash that Like, Subscribe and hit the bell. Want the raw CSV and sources? Check the pinned comment and description link. Drop which token surprised you most in the comments (Terra collapse or Solana rollercoaster?).

Sources: public historical market caps and major reporting (CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, mainstream coverage of the 2021 bull run and 2022 LUNA crash).
